title: How to work on Java here
summary: Resolve the Java language module, examine the exact source/type first, use project release/classpath explicitly, compile with javac evidence, and consult the Swing/JMS articles before writing integration code.
evidence_note: Grounded in the delivered Wire UI Swing and FederationBank Java ATM/JMS artifacts in oorexxapis(20260902-105429).zip; portable Java semantics are kept separate from project-specific authority rules.
procedure: Resolve/examine the exact .java source and symbol.
Read the relevant Swing/JMS/project article before changing integration code.
Compile with the project's declared --release and classpath.
Run project tests with assertions enabled where the project harness does so.
Return compiler/test evidence and a bounded diff.
invariants: Do not infer Java API or transport semantics from a class name alone.
Compilation success is necessary evidence, not proof of project semantic correctness.
Project authority boundaries remain outside presentation/transport code.
